What is NACST, and what does it offer?
NACST, or the Narayana Admission Cum Scholarship Test, is an online scholarship
examination that provides students with the opportunity to secure scholarships of up
to 90% for NEET, JEE, and Foundation courses at Narayana.
Who is eligible to appear for NACST?
Students studying in or passing Classes 5 to 12 are eligible to appear for NACST.
Students from Classes 5 and 6 are eligible for admission at select Narayana Offline
Coaching Centres, while all eligible classes (5–12) can opt for Narayana Live as
well as Offline Coaching at Narayana Centres, subject to course availability.
